paper_title: Predictions for Axion Couplings from ALP Cogenesis
notes: This is a theoretical prediction paper, not an experimental exclusion limit. The paper derives predicted ALP couplings (to photons, nucleons, electrons) as functions of ALP mass m_a and decay constant f_a from the ALP cogenesis mechanism. Figures 1–3 show predicted coupling bands (green regions) overlaid with existing experimental constraints and future experiment sensitivities, but the paper itself presents NO NEW MEASURED EXCLUSION LIMITS. The primary results are theoretical predictions of the f_a-m_a correlation (Eq. 2.17) and the resulting coupling predictions (Eqs. 3.10, 3.15, 3.18). While the paper discusses AxionPhoton, AxionNeutron, and AxionElectron couplings explicitly, the fundamental result is the f_a-m_a plane prediction from cogenesis. However, since the paper does not present data points on the f_a-m_a plane itself (only the derived coupling predictions), and the coupling predictions are presented as functions of m_a with model-dependent uncertainties (varying c_aγγ, c_aNN, c_aee from 1–10), extraction of precise numerical data_points is not feasible. The paper is a theory paper making predictions for future experiments to test, not reporting measured limits. | [VISION GATE B] vision notes assert the plotted axis belongs to AxionPhoton but the declared coupling is AxionMass — wrong panel/curve traced
